an10.67:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena Naḷakapānaṃ nāma Kosalānaṃ nigamo tad avasari.
an10.67:1.2: Tatra sudaṃ Bhagavā Naḷakapāne viharati Palāsavane.
an10.67:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā tadah' uposathe bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto nisinno hoti.
an10.67:1.4: Atha kho Bhagavā bahu-d-eva rattiṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ āmantesi
an10.67:2.5: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavato paccassosi.
an10.67:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā catuguṇaṃ saṃghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi, pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā. 2.
an10.67:3.2: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an10.67:3.4: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.67:4.1: Yassa kassaci āvuso saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, hiri natthi . . .
an10.67:4.4: paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, hāni yeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi.
an10.67:4.5: Seyyathā pi āvuso kālapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, hāyat' eva vaṇṇena, hāyati maṇḍalena, hāyati ābhāya, hāyati ārohapariṇāhena:
an10.67:4.6: evam eva kho āvuso yassa kassaci saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, hiri natthi . . .
an10.67:4.9: paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, hāni yeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi.

an10.67:5.10: micchādiṭṭhiko purisapuggalo ti āvuso parihānam etaṃ. 4.
